headline: Airbnb Bans Hosts From Requiring Guest Check-Out Chores
summary: Airbnb updated its policy to prohibit hosts from requiring guests to perform check-out chores such as stripping beds, washing dishes, or taking out the trash.
why: Airbnb is a major online marketplace for lodging and tourism, and changes to its platform rules directly impact host operations and user satisfaction.

impacts.name: Airbnb
impacts.why: Policy changes alter platform usability for both hosts and guests, though direct financial impacts remain to be seen.
